question: GQ-001
subject: the builders had no tests, and my first test of them proved nothing

the_finding.reading: the gates check ARTIFACTS. Nothing checked the BUILDERS — the passage index, the modern index, the catalogue migration, the page, the ingester, the search CLI.

the_structural_cause.which_one: corpus-integrity.mjs — the one I fixed after a probe failed on it
the_structural_cause.consequence: three times this session a probe measured my fixture instead of the thing, because the script could not be pointed at a copy

my_first_selftest_reproduced_the_defect.the_test_that_mattered: deleted rebuild-corpus.sh and re-ran — 4 of 7 STILL PASSED
my_first_selftest_reproduced_the_defect.why: three cases asserted sqlite behaviour and one asserted that a missing script changes nothing
my_first_selftest_reproduced_the_defect.worst_case: "--check changes nothing" passes when --check does not exist

now_in_the_suite: check-all runs 4 suites; the rebuild self-test gates every push
